title:
This type represents a cell for {@link UiCollapsibleGrid} spreadsheet, which contains an icon.

Expects the following props:

  - `icon`: the icon to display, should be the icon suffix, e.g. c3-icon-caret-up --> "caret-up"
  - `iconColor`: the color of the icon
  - `value`: (Optional) The text value to show after the icon.
name: IconCellTemplate
